properties.claim: A study cannot enter LITERATURE_LOCKED unless its source record, resolved claims, and all three independent audit artifacts are present.
properties.test_name: refuses LITERATURE_LOCKED with 0 sources

mutations.why: A study with no locked sources would be allowed to advance.
A study with no adjudicated claims would be allowed to advance.

mutations.find: if (audits.litA === 0) failures.push("literature/audits LIT-A artifact must exist (measured 0)");
mutations.replace: if (false) failures.push("literature/audits LIT-A artifact must exist (measured 0)");
mutations.why: The required independent LIT-A audit could be absent.
mutations.test_name: refuses LITERATURE_LOCKED with missing LIT-A audit

mutations.find: if (audits.litB === 0) failures.push("literature/audits LIT-B artifact must exist (measured 0)");
mutations.replace: if (false) failures.push("literature/audits LIT-B artifact must exist (measured 0)");
mutations.why: The required independent LIT-B audit could be absent.
mutations.test_name: refuses LITERATURE_LOCKED with missing LIT-B audit

mutations.find: if (audits.adjudication === 0) failures.push("literature/audits adjudication artifact must exist (measured 0)");
mutations.replace: if (false) failures.push("literature/audits adjudication artifact must exist (measured 0)");
mutations.why: The final adjudication artifact could be absent.
mutations.test_name: refuses LITERATURE_LOCKED with missing adjudication audit

mutations.find: if (unresolved !== 0) failures.push(`evidence-matrix unresolved claims must be 0 (measured ${unresolved})`);
mutations.replace: if (false) failures.push(`evidence-matrix unresolved claims must be 0 (measured ${unresolved})`);
mutations.why: A study with unresolved evidence would be allowed to advance.
mutations.test_name: refuses LITERATURE_LOCKED with an unresolved claim

properties.claim: A study cannot justify entering a state by claiming that the destination state is already recorded.
properties.test_name: refuses UNKNOWN and a circular destination check even with real artifact-shaped inputs

mutations.why: A transition whose only stated check is its destination would be accepted.

properties.claim: A study's transition ledger cannot accept an artifact from another study.
properties.test_name: refuses a row from another study and names both study ids

mutations.why: A valid-looking transition from a different study could enter this ledger.

properties.claim: Only rows belonging to this v3 study, tied to its frozen repository snapshot, and free of a legacy benchmark identity may enter its candidate registry.
properties.test_name: refuses re-adding benchmark: cdeb-v1 to a v3 row by naming expected and received identity

mutations.find: if ("benchmark" in row) throw identityError("benchmark (must be absent)", "absent", row.benchmark);
mutations.replace: if (false) throw identityError("benchmark (must be absent)", "absent", row.benchmark);
mutations.why: A legacy benchmark row could be relabelled as a v3 candidate.

mutations.find: if (row.study_id !== studyId) throw identityError("study_id", studyId, row.study_id);
mutations.why: A candidate belonging to another study could enter this registry.
mutations.test_name: refuses a foreign v3 study_id by naming expected and received identity

mutations.find: if (row.source_snapshot_sha !== expectedSnapshot) throw identityError("source_snapshot_sha", expectedSnapshot, row.source_snapshot_sha);
mutations.why: A candidate could be attributed to a different source snapshot.
mutations.test_name: refuses a source snapshot that differs from its frozen repository snapshot

properties.claim: A candidate associated with the legacy study cdeb-v1 cannot reach the registry as anything but ineligible.
properties.test_name: keeps a Record-Id named by the index as an ineligible visible row

mutations.why: No study-id-specific comparison exists: the index matcher never reads kind, so this property has no expressible control.

properties.claim: A repository bundle whose bytes differ from its frozen identity cannot be materialized for a study run.
properties.test_name: refuses a bundle whose bytes do not match the freeze

mutations.why: Tampered bundle bytes would be handed to the materializer.

properties.claim: Runnable code and active-study artifacts contain no personal filesystem path.
properties.test_name: forbids personal paths in runnable code and active-study artifacts

mutations.why: The current clean tree still passes when the scan is bypassed, so this test has no constructed personal-path control.

properties.claim: A study that has written phase invalidated about itself cannot be resolved as the active study, however the declaration is edited.
properties.test_name: refuses to make either invalidated predecessor the active study

mutations.why: An invalidated predecessor could be named active and resolve cleanly.
A declaration whose status and id disagree would resolve to whichever half the reader trusts.
mutations.test_name: refuses a declaration whose status and id disagree in either direction

properties.claim: An ordinary-source packet handed to a blind reviewer contains no CommitLore key line, including one a squashed commit embedded as indented prose.
properties.test_name: removes a whole record that a squashed commit embedded as indented prose

mutations.why: A squashed commit's embedded record would reach the reviewer that must be blind to it.
A packet still holding a record line would be reported clean.
mutations.test_name: refuses a packet that still carries a record line

properties.claim: A delivery result in which the injector never started, or never forwarded a byte, is an error rather than zero delivery.
properties.test_name: refuses a result in which the injector never ran, rather than reporting zero delivery

mutations.why: A harness failure would be published as a finding of zero delivery.
An injector forwarding nothing anywhere could not be told from one with nothing to say.

properties.claim: A reviewer response must account for every candidate it was given; silence is not coverage and an unknown id is not diligence.
properties.test_name: refuses a response that leaves part of its batch unmentioned

mutations.why: A reviewer that answered three of ten would be indistinguishable from one that answered all ten.
A verdict about a candidate that was never handed over would enter the corpus.
mutations.test_name: refuses invented ids and a candidate both judged and declined

properties.claim: A gate on which the two blind reviewers disagreed, with no third vote, fails rather than passing or being averaged.
properties.test_name: fails closed on a split pair with no third vote, and resolves by majority when there is one

mutations.find: if (third === undefined) return { passed: false, source: "unresolved" };
mutations.replace: if (third === undefined) return { passed: true, source: "unresolved" };
mutations.why: An unresolved disagreement would be rounded into a qualification.

mutations.find: if (left === undefined || right === undefined) return { passed: false, source: "unavailable" };
mutations.replace: if (left === undefined || right === undefined) return { passed: true, source: "unavailable" };
mutations.why: A candidate no reviewer judged would qualify.
mutations.test_name: treats a missing reviewer verdict as a failure, never as a pass

properties.claim: A buildability census with any undecided candidate cannot fix the study population.
properties.test_name: throws on the census as committed, because 62 dispositions are still open

mutations.find: const undecided = rows.filter((row) => row.disposition === null).map((row) => row.candidate_id);
mutations.why: An unfinished census would read as a fixed population and a pilot could start against it.

properties.claim: BUILDABLE cannot be claimed for a candidate whose oracle controls were never validated.
properties.test_name: refuses BUILDABLE without validated oracle controls

mutations.why: A candidate could enter the corpus asserting an oracle that does not exist.

properties.claim: An oracle that answers the same for a compliant and a ruled-out patch cannot measure revival.
properties.test_name: refuses an oracle that always answers the same, in either direction

mutations.why: An always-no oracle is deterministic and would score every revival as compliant.

properties.claim: A task author given the record, its reason or its anchor makes the task a description of the record.
properties.test_name: refuses a task author who was shown the record

mutations.why: The anti-circularity argument rests entirely on the task being authored off the record.

properties.claim: The four fixed repositories are strata, not a sample, and resampling them yields an interval about a population never sampled.
properties.test_name: resamples candidates within fixed repositories and never the repositories

mutations.why: This is the exact defect that invalidated the Stage 1 draft's interval.

properties.claim: An assigned episode that did not complete stays in the denominator as a failure.
properties.test_name: refuses an analysis set that dropped an assigned episode

mutations.why: Removing arm-dependent failures lets a treatment that prevents completion score as preventing revival.

properties.claim: An equal-weight average over four fixed strata is undefined when one is empty, and that is a stop.
properties.test_name: weights the four repositories equally and stops on an empty stratum

mutations.why: v3r1 failed on empty strata; silently averaging over the survivors changes the estimand without saying so.

properties.claim: Pilot continuation cannot read treatment-effect direction or magnitude.
properties.test_name: gates the pilot on feasibility alone and refuses a record carrying an effect

mutations.why: A feasibility file that reports the effect has already shown it to whoever decides to continue.

properties.claim: An unset runtime field is an uncontrolled difference between the arms.
properties.test_name: accepts a fully pinned lock and refuses an unregistered field

mutations.why: An unregistered knob is an unaudited difference the arms could carry.
